ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) distribution, concentrated primarily on the outer regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, mottled high-intensity contiguous region on the distal half of the left lobe extending from the leading edge toward the mid-lobe; fragmented high-intensity clusters along the distal trailing edge and tip of the right lobe; central fluke and proximal lobe regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes. Left lobe exhibits three primary, well-defined peaks. Right lobe displays a more jagged, fine-grained serration pattern with a notable secondary indentation near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature along the leading edges, sweeping upward and outward toward sharp, tapered apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several small, circular dark pixel voids nested within the high-intensity white patch on the distal left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct vertical high-contrast linear disruption (rake mark) on the mid-region of the right lobe, intersecting the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge degradation characterized by deep, non-uniform serrations and a significant notch on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric pigmentation where the left lobe contains a large, high-contrast white focal patch while the right lobe remains predominantly dark with peripheral speckling.
